body:
Part of #125. **Re-scoped 2026-08-28 after PR #135 (`f25bbb8`) landed** — read that PR first.

## What #135 already does

The terminal verb records `session_id` and `transcript_path` onto the attempt it ran, from
`CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID` and the job record under `$CLAUDE_JOB_DIR` (`currentSession`, `src/jobs.js`,
called from `finishAttempt` in `src/lifecycle.js`). A worker that completes, blocks or requests review
now leaves a resumable, priceable row. Do not rebuild that.

## What is still missing — the attempts that never file a verb

On this board: 10 `protocol_violation`, 5 `timed_out`, 2 `crashed`. None of those run a terminal verb,
so none gets a session under #135 — and they are exactly the attempts a human wants to `claude
--resume` for a post-mortem, and exactly the spend `hkb stats` still cannot see.

The dispatcher can fill them without a hook or a verb. It already reads the job id from the launch
log (`parseBackgroundedId`, `src/dispatch.js:492`), already reads the job record (`readJobState`,
`src/jobs.js`), and already lists `claude agents --json` each tick. Everything needed to name the
session is in hand one tick after launch.

## What

On the first tick where an attempt's job is matched, if the row has no `session_id`, write the same
`SESSION_FIELDS` the verb would — same `sessionUpdate`, same marker discipline #135 uses — from the
job record. Then, when the attempt is later written off as crashed/timed out/violated, the row
already carries what `priceOf` and `hkb show` need.

- Write only when absent; a row the verb has stamped is never touched.
- No new calls. No per-attempt call.
- Record early (the tick after launch), so the resume line is there while the attempt is still live.

## Done when

- An attempt the dispatcher writes off as `protocol_violation` still has `session_id` and
  `transcript_path`, and `hkb stats` prices it through the transcript fallback.
- A row already stamped by the verb is byte-identical after the tick.
- `node --test test/jobs.test.js` covers: unmatched job → nothing; matched, empty row → written;
  matched, stamped row → untouched.

## Contract

- Reuse `currentSession`/`readJobState` from `src/jobs.js` and `sessionUpdate` from `src/model.js`
  as #135 left them. Do not add a second field set or a second marker.
- Touch only `src/dispatch.js`, `src/jobs.js`, `test/jobs.test.js`.
goal: one tick after launch a claude-bg attempt row carries session_id and transcript_path
title: The dispatcher records a background worker's session from claude agents, no hook needed
